answer: Use carrier-anchored SIM identity: one human, one verified mobile line, one agent. First, the applicant registers a SIM whose carrier has KYC-checked the owner, and the carrier signs a token binding that number to the agent. Second, the network rejects any second agent claiming the same SIM and flags bulk activations. Third, the binding is rechecked every 90 days; a revoked SIM instantly suspends the agent. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 KYC SIMs at $8 each plus $120,000 in fees and 40 days of checks. Like a mesa above a lagoon, one ferrous anchor holds while copycat ripples wash away.
